draft: Launch fields only, read by scripts/agent-harness.mjs (#48); the full schema and its conformance cases are #312's.

signIn.readBy: a run is BLOCKED until the agent is signed in
signIn.signedIn: exit code 0; the output is never kept

readOnlyJob.readBy: DeepBuild's own jobs: read-only sandbox, none of the user's config or MCP servers, no bypass flag, prompt on stdin

usage.readBy: every run prints its cost and is held to its cap
usage.costFrom: nothing: on a plan Codex reports tokens only, and no rate card is verified, so a token cap stands in for the cost cap
usage.tokens: the rollout's last token_count info.total_token_usage; input_tokens includes cached_input_tokens, which is taken back out

transcripts.readBy: a run keeps its session's own rollout
